{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Planet_Defender.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Planet/Legends|planetary]]-based [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]] at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]
{{Quote|We'll never make it through unless the fighters can eliminate the ion cannons on those Star Destroyers!|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
An '''ion cannon''' was a weapon which fired highly ionized particles or highly ionized plasma.

==Description==
{{Quote|A weapon that neutralizes all power to our ships, leaving the targets defenseless.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
Ion cannons were energy weapons that were similar to [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Instead of firing destructive blasts, the energy bolts disabled all electrical and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems aboard a target. Instead of causing direct physical damage to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ion cannon blast overloaded and fused circuitry, computers, flight control systems, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], weapons, communications, and [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] systems.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Low-powered ion cannon blasts could produce small, localized effects and cause minor system failures, while higher-intensity blasts were capable of crippling starships completely for several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. Ion cannon blasts were not stopped by [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] unless the shields were reconfigured to counter them. However, if shields were reconfigured to stop ion cannon shots, then they would be ineffective against regular laser blasts.<ref name="EGWT" />

Ion [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] fired particles that seriously interfered with the operation of electronics and computer systems, shorting circuits and often disabling them outright, in much the same manner as an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]]. The actual physical damage would sometimes result in fused joints on machines, due to the heat produced.<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> Ion cannons could also slow down malfunctioning door shutters or otherwise disable shield generators, as evidenced by the [[Fondor shipyard assault]] and the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Dubrillion]], respectively.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

The ion cannon was not without its weaknesses, however. For instance, it lacked tight-beam accuracy, to the point that a ground-based ion cannon might hit the defender's own battle stations as well as its intended targets.<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> Moreover, [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] would have crewmen that could repair any damage done, which would allow the vessel to continue fighting.

==History==
{{Quote|Order the defense towers to fire ion cannons and turbolasers at will!|[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]], ordering the ground-side defensive cannons during the [[Battle of Iziz]] |<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Malevolence_firing.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] fires its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]].]]

They were often used on capital ships, such as [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], to facilitate the capture of enemy vessels or disable them to allow safe close-range fire. They also helped to drop shields prior to destroying enemy vessels. Fighters such as the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]], [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunter]] and the [[Razor-class starfighter|Razor fighter]] in some cases, were also equipped with ion cannons, of much smaller size. Ships owned by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were sometimes modified to use ion cannons, such as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].

A more powerful form of the ion cannon, the massive [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]], was used in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], mounted on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] ship the ''Malevolence''. It could disable [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and stop entire fleets in their tracks with a single shot. The weapon overloaded near the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] thanks to the efforts of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} sister ship, the ''[[Devastation]]'', was even larger and more powerful than the ''Malevolence''. The ship's ion cannons were as powerful as a shot from the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], and could destroy any capital ship or even a planet. They were so powerful because the ''Devastation''{{'s}} pair of ion cannons and the Death Star's superlaser ran on the same type of power source: [[Force crystal]]s.

They could also be planet-based weapons, as seen in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used a stolen V-150 Planet Defender to disable the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], allowing a transport to escape through the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade.

[[File:Ion_Cannon_Turret.jpg|thumb|200px|A Y-wing fighter firing its ion cannon]]

Certain types of ion cannons were meant to do more physical damage with electrical disruption as a plus. These types of ion cannon, however, had a low firing rate and were often just replaced with heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].

One type of ion cannon was the [[v-200 ion cannon]], used to break through shielding and bring down heavily armored vehicles. There was also a specialized version for taking down the heavily armored spacetroopers.

The Galactic Empire experimented with ion cannons by modifying [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to become All Terrain Ion Cannons, or AT-ICs, effectively creating a mobile ion cannon. The AT-ICs saw limited action during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Due to their unique mission profile as a disabling weapon, ion cannons have been popular in franchise video games, particularly the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] and [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] series. Ion cannons play a significant role in starfighter combat in these games, in contrast to the films, where starfighters are never seen to fire ion weapons. In the ''X-Wing'' series, a few seconds of sustained fire from a single fighter's ion cannons can permanently disable any capital ship that has lost shields, while it might take several minutes to destroy the same ship using lasers.

In another departure from the movie appearance, the discharge of an ion blast was colored cerulean blue in both series (all of which predate the blue laser bolts seen in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]).

Despite the real-world physics of spaceflight, disabling a craft with ion cannons in the ''X-wing'' series of games had the effect of stopping it dead in space rather than simply crippling its flight control system.<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> Contradictorily, the use of a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] starfighter's ion cannons to disable [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor's]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] just above the surface of [[Gerrard V]] in a cutscene appeared to disable the Imperial craft's flight-control systems, but not its [[P-s5.6 twin ion engine/Legends|engine system]], resulting in the interceptor flying in a straight line without being able to deviate from its course.<ref name="RS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
